name: UAT-10608
description: UAT-10608 is an opportunistic threat cluster targeting public‑facing web applications built on Next.js and React Server Components, exploiting CVE‑2025‑55182 to execute remote code without authentication. The actors employ a custom NEXUS Listener framework to automate credential harvesting—collecting SSH keys, cloud tokens, API keys, Kubernetes service account tokens, and Docker environment data—and exfiltrate the information over HTTP to a web GUI. Within 24 hours of launch, the campaign compromised more than 766 hosts across multiple regions. Financial gain drives operations, with attacks focused on telecommunications, government, IT, defense, critical infrastructure, healthcare, and financial‑services sectors in China and the United States.
